description: Extract text from a .docx file so it can be turned into a ledger for customs_check. Paragraphs come out one per line; table rows come out as "| a | b | c |" lines. Merged cells are marked "↔", meaning "this cell is merged with the one to its left and holds no value of its own" — do not read it as a missing value. A vertically merged cell repeats the value above it, which is what a reader of the document sees. Reads exactly the one path given, opens it read-only, and refuses anything larger than 20 MB. No other file is touched, no network is used, nothing is written. Only a path ending in .docx is accepted: legacy .doc/.wps are a different binary format and PDF is not parsed on purpose — a PDF table loses its cell structure, and guessing it produces a ledger that is wrong in ways the check cannot detect.

path.description: Absolute or working-directory-relative path to the .docx file.

name: customs_read_docx
title: Extract readable text from a .docx
